name: Unraid
warnings: Point Styx at Unraid itself (its HTTPS port, e.g. https://192.168.1.10:443, or :8443 if a reverse proxy holds 443), not at a reverse proxy in front of it: Unraid redirects to the hostname it is reached by, which would leave Styx.
Unraid uses a self-signed certificate: TLS verification is disabled for this upstream.
Takes over the root of the hostname for this browser (one service at a time).
